genxml.title: Hub block transfer engine registers and control bits outside the census

struct.name: IIO_WID
struct.doc: Widget identification register of the Hub widget. Offset and field layout are from the public header. The header gives no access type and no reset value, so the The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPR
struct.doc: Local access protection register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no fields, access type or reset. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPO
struct.doc: Protection override register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no unlock value or behaviour, so none is imported. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_IGFX_1
struct.doc: Graphics node and widget register 1, the twin of iio_igfx_0 in the census. The header gives both the same field layout: widget number in bits 3:0, node number in bits 12:4, processor number at bit 16 and a valid bit at bit 20. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG0
struct.doc: Scratch register 0. The header names its bit uses for software only and gives a mask of the bits that exist, 0x0000000f00f11fff. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG1
struct.doc: Scratch register 1, the twin of register 0. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_ITTE
struct.doc: Big-window translation entry n, for n from 0 to 6. Entry 0 is at the register offset and each later entry is eight bytes further on. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_IBNA_0
struct.doc: Notification address of engine 0, the twin of the engine 1 slot in the census. Offset and name are from the public header. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_0
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 0. Offset and name are from the public header. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_1
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 1. Offset and name are from the public header. The IRIX register table confirms the access.
